title: Watch one row accumulate
purpose: Four ordered updates produce y[0] from row 0 of W and the shared x.
contract: W [3,4] times x [4] produces a fresh y [3].
The row-0 accumulator starts at zero and ends at -3.
Read-only inputs; the output is stored after the reduction.
